mechanism: STING V154M gain-of-function mice; Fura Red ratiometric flow cytometry of basal cytosolic Ca2+ in splenic T cells
sentence: Using Fura Red -mediated ratiometric measurement to study basal Ca2+ levels, we demonstrated that basal Ca2+ levels were higher in CD4+ and CD8+ T cells from STING GOF mice compared to their WT controls, suggesting that the Ca2+-NFAT signaling pathway in STING GOF T cells could be associated with the induction of their exhaustion (Fig.
justification: Constitutive STING activation raises resting cytosolic calcium in primary T cells, the reverse direction of the Srikanth model where STIM1 restrains STING: here the STING end of the axis sets the calcium set-point.

mechanism: 4 h DMXAA treatment of wild-type splenocytes in vitro, phenocopying the GOF basal Ca2+ level
sentence: After 4 h, DMXAA-treated CD4+ and CD8+ T cells presented an increase of their basal Ca2+ levels, similar to those observed in untreated STING GOF T cells (Fig.
justification: Acute pharmacological STING activation is sufficient to raise basal Ca2+ in wild-type T cells, so the calcium rise is a consequence of STING signalling itself and not of the chronic GOF genotype.

mechanism: 24 h DMXAA treatment of wild-type splenocytes; total NFATc1 mean fluorescence intensity by flow cytometry
sentence: After 24 h, DMXAA-treated cells also showed an upregulation of NFATc1 to the same extent as untreated STING GOF T cells (Fig.
justification: Links STING directly to a level-2 calcium effector: STING activation drives the Ca2+-calmodulin-calcineurin-NFAT arm, giving the STIM1/STING axis a transcriptional output in T cells.

mechanism: RNA-seq of CXCR5+PD-1+ Tfh cells from Bcl6+/- mice; Stim1 among the downregulated genes when one Bcl6 copy is lost
sentence: As shown in Figure S7, when one copy of the Bcl6 gene was missing, CXCR5+PD-1+ Tfh cells differentially expressed many genes; among those downregulated were Stim1 and Plcg1 (which code for STIM1 and PLCgamma1, respectively) that both impinge on calcium signaling downstream of TCR activation.
justification: A transcriptional input to the anchor: BCL6 sustains STIM1 expression in follicular helper T cells, so the amount of the ER calcium sensor available to gate SOCE (and to restrain STING) is itself set by a lineage transcription factor.

mechanism: two-photon intravital imaging of OT-II T cell-MD4 B cell contacts in the follicle with the FRET calcium reporter YC-Nano-50CD; mean DeltaRt/R0 29% in Bcl6+/+ versus 8% in Bcl6+/- contacts
sentence: Quantitatively, Bcl6+/- OT-II T cells exhibited significantly lower mean DeltaRt/R0 values than control T cells (Figure 3B; mean +- SEM of mean DeltaRt/R0 values for 65 Bcl6+/+ versus 64 Bcl6+/- contacts: 29% +- 6% versus 8% +- 4%, p < 0.01).
justification: The functional half of the BCL6 result: losing one Bcl6 allele cuts the calcium response of T cells during B cell contact in vivo, so the transcriptional control of STIM1 by BCL6 has a measured calcium consequence, not just a transcript change.
